name: Process-bus maintenance isolation boundary
summary: Marks the defined separation of a selected bay's digital-secondary interfaces for maintenance planning.
description: Marks the defined separation of a selected bay's digital-secondary interfaces for maintenance planning. Digital substation interfaces carry measurements, status and control information between primary equipment and protective devices. Measurement streams, event messages and time synchronization are separate dependencies even when they share an Ethernet network.

In a digital substation bay, a merging unit digitizes local measurements and a protective relay subscribes to the assigned data stream. The command return path and communication-health indications are drawn separately. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Named bay data interfaces” at the input and “Defined process-bus boundary” at the output. A network boundary is not primary equipment isolation.
